name: Furlong
overview: The furlong, a unit of measurement equivalent to one-eighth of a mile, appears in Scripture to convey precise distances in both everyday and prophetic contexts. Luke 24:13 notes that the village of Emmaus was about sixty furlongs from Jerusalem, illustrating a measurable journey. John 11:18 similarly describes Bethany as being approximately fifteen furlongs, or two miles, from Jerusalem, emphasizing the proximity of significant locations. In Revelation 21:16, the use of twelve thousand furlongs to measure the New Jerusalem highlights the vastness and perfection of the city, demonstrating the furlong's role in conveying both practical and symbolic dimensions of biblical geography.
